current: qip_edge::cell::Cell::work never calls out to the centre on its hot path, by construction (ADR 0008). A cell trades on a pre-granted, signed, expiring CapitalEnvelope and on the last policy it applied. It stops only when that envelope's own clock runs out (the envelope_expiry gate), whatever hosts the warm plane. With no centre, nothing new can arrive, so no new policy or grant is activated: capital and policy reach a cell only through the mesh exchange. In production, qip-edge-node's serve loop (main.rs:866-930) logs a failed mesh exchange and still calls run_pass -> Cell::work (main.rs:888, pass.rs:117/203) under the simulated feed. current: No Fabric and no separate ledger sink exist. The in-tree path that carries a cell's financial outcomes to the centre's ledger drops them during an outage, which the requirement forbids. A cell's orders, fills and crosses reach the centre only inside a CellStateDelta, which is per-interval and incremental (qip-edge/src/mesh.rs:201-254). The uplink retries on a bounded ladder and then dead-letters the delta (mesh.rs:409). While the circuit is open it refuses the delta outright. The node keeps dead letters in memory only, capacity 64, with no redrive (qip-edge-node/src/mesh.rs:64-69). qip-mesh/src/spine.rs:14 states the up direction is 'not durable'. So while the centre (and with it the ledger) is unreachable, outcomes do not accumulate durably for later commit. The cell's local journal still records its own decisions, but nothing replays it into the centre. The centre's EventLog refusing a new append rather than evicting a Permanent record is a different behaviour: it refuses the write, it does not retain a backlog.
evidence: backend/crates/edge/qip-edge/src/mesh.rs:409 (dead_lettered: deltas that spent the whole ladder)
backend/crates/apps/qip-edge-node/src/mesh.rs:64-69 (DEAD_LETTER_CAPACITY = 64, in memory, 'a lost message is superseded by the next one')
backend/crates/libs/qip-events/src/topic.rs:599-638 (Irreplaceable retention classes at the centre: a different failure mode)
gap: An outage longer than the retry ladder loses that interval's outcomes from the centre's books. What is needed: outcome-bearing deltas, or a dedicated outcome stream, spooled durably at the cell (qip_transport::spool::DurableSpool already exists and serves the capital downlink) and retried without limit, then the Fabric outcome partitions under P1 retention once E03 builds them. None of this needs Spanner or a refused crate.

current: CellConfig::max_staleness now fires. The cell records when each venue's feed was last heard, on its own clock, from Cell::on_bytes and from Cell::feed_heartbeat, the feed handler's statement that the feed is connected though nothing moved. Once a venue has been silent for longer than max_staleness every order bound for it is refused under GATE_SILENT_FEED ('silent_feed'): Cell::route_for refuses the signal, Cell::venue_for stops offering the venue, and cycle admission refuses a cycle with a leg there. Strategies on venues still heard are untouched, and the strategy resumes when the feed is heard again. The gate does not depend on the strategy reading a feature of the silent instrument, which was the only thing that stopped one before. In production qip-edge-node's SimulatedFeed::publish calls feed_heartbeat on every pass, because that feed publishes differences and a quiet market publishes nothing.
verification: cargo test -p qip-edge --test venue_failure a_venue_whose_feed_stalls_gets_no_new_order; cargo test -p qip-edge-node --test feed_recovery a_simulated_venue_that_did_not_move. Mutations, each restored byte-for-byte: the venue_withheld refusal removed from route_for, the stalled venue still received an order (left [(XLON, obj-ACME), (XPAR, obj-BETA)] right [(XPAR, obj-BETA)]); the heartbeat removed from SimulatedFeed::publish, a quiet venue was refused as a silent feed after sixty seconds.
notes: Closed in RES round 3. The test's strategy is a constant rule that reads no feature, so the feature graph cannot be what stops it. Silence is judged per venue, not per feed or instrument. A venue never heard is not judged silent: a book handed to the cell by Cell::track with no feed behind it has no silence to measure, and the other book gates apply to it. Not deployable: execution_nodes = {} in every environment.

current: no cell-autonomous 'local playbook' exists. The only unwind mechanism, qip_edge::cell::Cell::disposition_intents (cell.rs:3178-3320), is centre-driven (ADR 0080): it acts only on Dispositions the centre shipped on the policy payload, not on a decision the cell reaches itself. It routes through the same Cell::route_for gates as new orders (cell.rs:3325-3337). So when the lost feed shows up as a sequence gap, a disposition at that venue is refused under 'stale_book' rather than executed as a hedge. When the feed simply goes silent, the book is never marked stale (see RES-084), so a disposition would route against the frozen pre-outage book. Neither outcome is a local hedge-or-exit playbook.

current: A feed loss is in the journal at both ends. When a venue's feed has been silent past CellConfig::max_staleness the next pass records Decision::FeedSilent {venue, last_heard, limit_ms}, once per stall rather than once per pass and before the halt check. When the feed is heard again Cell::feed_heartbeat records Decision::FeedReconciled {venue, silent_from, resting_orders, stale_books}: the interval the cell could not see, how many orders it still had open at that venue across it, and how many of the venue's books are still awaiting a rebuild.
